title: AI Museum Dataset Site
tagline: Web-based visualization to support an independent study in Fall 2025
summary: is a research artifact supporting a 2025-2026 independent study on multimodal AI and cultural heritage sites.

title: Born in the Anthropocene
tagline: An interactive narrative exploring a sustainable future based in collective welfare and critical thought
summary: is a 3-part interactive narrative implemented using Twine and p5.js. Users navigate a society founded on collective welfare, postmodern education, and multigenerational, communal family structures.
role: Writer, Graphics Artist, Twine Developer, p5.js Developer

title: TravelMate
tagline: An interactive travel planning web application
summary: is an interactive travel planning web application built with Django and HTML. Users input their dates, destination, and activities to receive custom AI and API powered weather forecasts, packing lists, and additional travel tips.

title: Poetic Alt Text Resource
tagline: A web-based reference on creative and poetic alt text authorship developed for the Fulton County Public Art Futures Lab
summary: a supplementary resource for the Fulton County Public Art Futures Lab and featured in their celebration of the 36th Anniversary of the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA).

title: Black Women's Cambridge
tagline: A research-through-design study apply Black feminist geographies to Critical GIS
summary: a research project conducted under the supervision of Fabio Duarte of the MIT Senseable City Lab during my time at the MIT Summer Research Program
